_doc: Thresholds for the public-funnel audit. Two-tier policy: 'required' fails the audit and is meant to be CI-gating; 'warning' is logged but never gates the build until the underlying tooling is pinned to a specific version. Structural fallback rules are always required.

lighthouse._doc: Lighthouse CLI scores (0.0–1.0). Active only when a 'lighthouse' or 'lhci' binary is on PATH. Until the CLI version is pinned, performance stays warning-only — measurements depend too much on the host CPU / browser version to gate CI on them. Accessibility, SEO and best-practices are deterministic enough to gate.

fallback_playwright._doc: When the Lighthouse CLI is not available we fall back to a structural Playwright audit. All structural rules are required: they encode regressions we never want to ship (missing H1, missing meta, leaking API keys, surfacing Pexels attribution).
